disclaimer: Fictional-game catalog research. No recipes, doses-as-how-to, or synthesis. Scores 0-100 or null. Enjoyment/euphoria first; rush usually N/A; compulsiveness usually low.

notes.2c_includes: PiHKAL 2C + Trachsel/Index alkyl-haloalkyl-sulfur + bk-2C-B/HOT/N-alkyl + tusi mislabel record. Empty T-numbers without structures excluded.
notes.nbome_includes: Named 25x-NBOMe/NBOH/NBF/NB/NBMD + NB3OMe/NB4OMe grids + notable atypicals. Tryptamine/lysergamide N-benzyl excluded.
notes.dox_includes: DOx + Aleph + TMA/TMA-2 + Ganesha + FLY/DragonFLY + 3C-E/P + identity flag for 3C-B.

compounds.name: 2C-B

feel.headline: Tactile candy. The star. Also the name they stamp on pink powder that isn't this.

enjoyment.note: Festival star. Lab studies (Gonzalez 2015, Mallaroni 2023) back the candy/talk myth.

euphoria.note: Warm body + lift. Not an MDMA roll. Entactogen-ish reports are mixed.

rush.note: Oral climb, not a rush.

compulsiveness.note: Festival redose because the night is good, not because they cannot stop.

reinforcement.note: People come back to 2C-B. Not a binge chemical.

compounds.npc_line: If they say tusi, check the color. If they say 2C-B, that's the one the old heads actually liked.
compounds.gaps: Human half-life still thin. Erox aphrodisiac marketing is lore.

compounds.name: 2C-C

feel.headline: 2C-B's softer halogen twin. Same party, less voltage.

enjoyment.note: Mellow, warm, less sparkle than B.

rush.note: No rush.

compulsiveness.note: Rodent CPP exists (Kim 2021). Human reports are not binge stories.

compounds.npc_line: Softer halogen. Fine if you wanted a couch, rude if you wanted 2C-B.

compounds.name: 25I-NBOMe

feel.headline: Never label as LSD. Blotter that can kill. Metallic tongue is the tell.

enjoyment.note: Visuals can be huge. Consistency is the problem. Death pile is not a low-enjoyment score.

euphoria.note: Present when it is a trip and not a medical event.

rush.note: Insufflated slam / blotter ramp. Onset salience, not pleasure-rush.

compulsiveness.note: Low. 'This acid is weak' redose is mislabeled onset, not fiending.

duration.onset: fast if insufflated, medium on blotter

compounds.receptor_vs_human: High-affinity 5-HT2A agonist (lab). Human = ED clusters + forums. Do not rank enjoyment from Ki.
compounds.npc_line: If the tab is bitter and the tongue goes dead, it is not acid. Do not sell it as acid.
compounds.gaps: No controlled human PK. Receptor nM is not a trip.

compounds.name: 25B-NBOMe

feel.headline: The other N-bomb. Same blotter crime, same hospital.

enjoyment.note: Some heads say warmer than I. Thin sample.

rush.note: Onset salience, not a pyro rush.

compounds.receptor_vs_human: Lab agonist + rodent DA/CPP. Human = same blotter crime as 25I.
compounds.npc_line: B as in bromo, B as in the other tab that wasn't acid.

sources.title: Clin Toxicol 2022 25B cluster sold as LSD

compounds.name: DOM

feel.headline: STP. The Summer of Love overstayed. Fat tablets lasted into the next life.

enjoyment.note: Real psychedelic. Snyder clinical notes. People did seek it.

rush.note: Delayed come-up. Impatient redose is the trap, not compulsiveness.

compulsiveness.note: Nobody STP-binges. They wait, then they are still high on Monday.

compounds.npc_line: Serenity, Tranquility, Peace. The tablet did not read the flyer.
